text:
claire-marketing: Need a compact 'Inference Snapshot' creative bundle for next Tues: one infographic (single PNG + fig) that visualizes cost vs latency with 3 callouts, a speaker-quote card, 3 social sizes, and a tiny inbound routing flow (webinar CTA -> LP -> nurture -> SDR). Priority: infographic + routing.

ren-design: Ok. Visual directions? I can do 'experimental data card' (mini charts + numbers) or 'system map' (icons + annotations). Which? Also need logo rules and copy limits for story tile.

claire-marketing: Go 'experimental data card' for the infographic, system map as alternate. Story tile headline max 6 words. Use full lockup on hero, stacked on small. Include tiny footer: 'Representative examples; results vary.'

jordan-motion: I can provide 3 keyframes for story and a 5s loop for hero. Will keep layers export-ready and supply MP4 + PNG keyframes. Tag naming: prefix with "export_".

ash-growth: Routing note: include UTM example `?utm_source=webinar&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=inference_snapshot_v1` and a recommended CTA: 'Watch demo & claim credits'. I'll drop 2 subject-line variants into the doc.

assets-bot: EXPORT CHECKLIST: required artboards 1080x1080, 1200x628, 1080x1920, 1920x1080. Deliver: PNG 1x/2x, layered .fig, MP4 (story), color tokens, font files, and AA contrast notes.

ren-design: I'll push two quick comps into Figma in ~36h, prioritizing the infographic and routing microdiagram. jordan-motion: I'll sync layer names now.

claire-marketing: Thanks team  prioritize infographic + routing microdiagram, then quote card and socials. Review sync tomorrow 11am PT.
